notes: County Elections page (kaufmancounty.net/237/Elections) links 'View election results' to results.enr.clarityelections.com/TX/Kaufman/. Check 1 (updated script, election-day precinct votes counted separately): 2024 general EID 122824 7/8 night updates with election-day precinct votes; 2026 primary EID 125939 10/11; 2026 runoff EID 126350 6/7. Kaufman's Clarity files stamp times in Eastern time (EST/EDT): the first night update of each election is at about 8:00 PM Eastern, which is poll close at 7:00 PM Central, so local Central times here are the Clarity times minus one hour. The script's 'first update with election-day precinct votes' for the runoff (5/6/2026 2:14:33 PM EDT) is a pre-election update with small test-like totals, not election night; the first election-night one is 9:27:59 PM EDT (8:27 PM CDT). Candidate-only election-day precinct sums were also computed from the cached files and agree.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LIVE (election-day precinct numbers in several election-night updates), so the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT; confidence high because all were settled by check 1.
